site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO/ECDC confirmed 11 total Andes hantavirus cases as of 13–15 May with no new cases or deaths since previous update; three deaths total. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona with 87 passengers and 35 crew; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; Arctic schedule uncertain pending health authority clearance.

site.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
site.desc: Index case (Dutch male, 70, died 11 Apr) took 4-month road trip 27 Nov 2025–1 Apr 2026 through Chile, Uruguay, Argentina before boarding; Dutch couple believed to have contracted virus during South America visit pre-boarding per AP 13 May. Genetic analysis (El País, 11 May) confirms Andes strain similar to Argentina 2018–19 strains with no new mutations; Malbrán Institute trapping/testing rodents along route.

site.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET
site.desc: France confirmed first hantavirus case (Le Monde, 11 May): one of five repatriated Hondius passengers tested PCR-positive; critically ill French woman on ECMO artificial lung at Bichat Hospital Paris. French government mandated 42-day quarantine with 22 potential contact cases identified across international flights.

site.name: ZURICH / GENEVA
site.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena 24 Apr; symptoms onset 01 May, tested positive Andes virus 05 May at University Hospital Zurich. Illumina sequencing confirmed Andes variant with high similarity to Argentina 2018–19 strains and no new mutations (El País, 11 May); wife asymptomatic and isolating.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: 18 American passengers coordinated to Offutt AFB and transferred to National Quarantine Center at UNMC per AP 13 May; 15 quarantined at NQU including content creator Jake Rosmarin (asymptomatic, 42-day quarantine). One symptomatic individual in UNMC biocontainment; Dr. Stephen Kornfeld cleared and released 14 May after inconclusive swabs resolved negative per AP 14 May. CDC confirmed no US cases resulting from this outbreak per CDC Newsroom 08 May.
